title: Descriptions
description: Label-and-value pairs, set as a list: the invoice header, the record detail, the spec sheet.
usage: For reading a record. The moment the pairs become inputs, it is a form and Field takes over. Keep labels short and values complete; the pair is the sentence.
a11y: A real dl: term and description stay paired for assistive technology. Do not fake the pairing with two loose columns of divs.
